newsitem.title: DUBAI: Foreigners invest in 340 Saudi industry projects.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners invest in 340 Saudi industry projects.

text.p: Foreigners had invested in 340 industrial projects in Saudi Arabia worth a total of 88.5 billion riyals ($23.6 billion) until August 1996, the industry and electricity minister was quoted as saying on Monday.
Hashem bin Abdullah bin Hashem Yamani did not say what share of the total capital invested in the projects came from foreigners.
The official Saudi Press Agency also quoted Yamani as saying "the ministry gave the issue of developing the foreign investment law a special importance".
Last month he said the foreign capital law was being reviewed to introduce more incentives to international investors.
